subject: Northstar HQ demo — access plan, NDA, and calendar confirmation
messages:
From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@northstarretail.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@northstarretail.com
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Northstar HQ visit — proposed dates and NDA

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. The leadership team at Northstar wants an onsite at your Novato HQ to meet the product and ops teams and talk through latency/cost tradeoffs for our store-scale rollout.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Aug 8 — full day (preferred)
- Wed Aug 9 — morning only
- Fri Aug 11 — afternoon only

We need to loop in Security to review the data flow and the NDA. I attached a short security questionnaire and our standard visit rules. Can you confirm whether Aug 8 works, whether you can reserve a small conference room on 3rd floor with AV, and whether you can provide visitor badges and a parking pass?

Also attaching our Mutual NDA for signature (attached: Northstar_Draft_NDA.pdf). If you prefer DocuSign, send me the link and I’ll get it routed to legal.

Best,
Elaine Wu
Director of Digital Ops
Northstar Retail
Attachment: Northstar_Draft_NDA.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: Northstar_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@northstarretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Northstar HQ visit — proposed dates and NDA

Hi Elaine — great to hear and thanks for sending the questionnaire. Aug 8 is available and we can host a full-day workshop. Quick confirmations below and next steps: 

What we’ll provide:
- Conference room: Suite 3B (3rd floor) — capacity 12, HDMI + AirPlay + room mic
- Visitor badges and one parking pass per external attendee (drop-off at lobby)
- Lunch: boxed lunches (please share dietary restrictions)

Security/legal next steps:
- I’ll upload your NDA to DocuSign by EOD and route it to our legal ops for countersignature.
- For the questionnaire, Ben (cc’d) will reply with our security contact and sample logs we can share ahead of the visit.

Can you confirm headcount and arrival time for Aug 8? If you need a projector check at 9:00am, we can schedule AV test at 8:30.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 11:19:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Northstar HQ visit — proposed dates and NDA

Marissa/ Sofia — I can get the security checklist answered and send a concise packet. Items I’ll include: 
- SOC2 scope summary + contact (sec-ops@redwood.ai)
- Sample access/logging export (anonymized)
- Data retention policy excerpt (what we provide to customers for on-prem/private options)
- Onsite rules (no device photography in sensitive labs)

I’ll target a draft packet by Mon 7/17. Marissa — can you confirm Suite 3B availability and add parking pass to the visitor list? Also can AV run a mic test at 8:30 on Aug 8?

— Ben

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@northstarretail.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jul 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Northstar HQ visit — proposed dates and NDA

All — Suite 3B is confirmed for Tue Aug 8 from 08:00–17:30. AV helper assigned (Jamal). Parking: we have one reserved space in visitor lot (Permit #NV-42) and two overflow passes for the campus lot (shuttle available).

I uploaded the floorplan and a visitor packet to our shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_link (floorplan: HQ_floorplan_level3.png). Elaine — I added a placeholder calendar invite for Aug 8 09:00–12:30 (internal), I will send the final calendar when DocuSign is complete and headcount confirmed.

Note to internal team: add sec-ops@redwood.ai to the inbox thread for any follow-ups.

— Marissa
Director, Customer Events
Attachment: HQ_floorplan_level3.png (image/png)

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@northstarretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, sec-ops@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 Jul 2028 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Northstar HQ visit — confirmed: Aug 8, DocuSign, calendar invite

Hi Elaine — quick update and confirmation.

- Aug 8 is locked in (Suite 3B, AV test 8:30, workshop 9:00–16:00).
- I’ve uploaded your NDA to DocuSign: https://docusign.com/embedded-sign/abc1234 — you should see a request from "Redwood Legal". Please sign and I’ll route for countersignature. Attached is the signed copy after countersign: Northstar_Signed_NDA.pdf.
- Marissa reserved visitor parking (Permit NV-42) and shared the floorplan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_link
- Please reply with final headcount, arrival times, and any dietary restrictions by Tue 7/26 so we can finalize catering.

If anything changes (reschedule or extra guests) we can adjust but this is the plan for now. Looking forward to hosting the team.

Best,
Sofia
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Northstar_Signed_NDA.pdf (application/pdf)
